extract_cpp_documentation: extract documentation from C++ header files and output docstring definitions for Python bindings
sanitize_cpp_names: sanitize C++ names by converting operators to readable identifiers and stripping template parameters
process_doxygen_comments: process Doxygen comments by converting tags like \param and \brief into formatted markdown-style text
build_parallel_extraction: build parallel extraction of C++ header documentation using clang libclang with thread-based concurrency
generate_docstring_header: generate a C++ header file containing static docstring constants for pybind11 Python bindings
